bug_info.bug_desc: A legal C.LI HINT form is incorrectly reported as an illegal instruction.
bug_info.fix_hint: Do not raise the illegal flag for the destination-x0 C.LI HINT encoding.

bug_info.bug_desc: The decoder treats the destination-x0 C.LUI HINT form as illegal instead of preserving only the separate reserved-immediate check.
bug_info.fix_hint: Accept the HINT destination form while retaining illegality for the reserved zero immediate.

bug_info.bug_desc: Zero-shift compressed right-shift HINT encodings are rejected as illegal.
bug_info.fix_hint: Allow the zero-shift forms to decode without asserting an illegal instruction.

bug_info.bug_desc: C.SLLI HINT encodings with destination x0 or a zero shift amount are incorrectly rejected.
bug_info.fix_hint: Remove illegality conditions that apply only because the encoding is a HINT.

bug_info.bug_desc: C.EBREAK selection ignores the source-register field, so other destination-x0 encodings enter the wrong decode path.
bug_info.fix_hint: Require both register fields to match the C.EBREAK encoding before selecting it.

bug_info.bug_desc: The subgroup conditions misclassify destination-x0/source-nonzero HINTs and do not explicitly constrain the C.JALR case.
bug_info.fix_hint: Partition the subgroup using both register fields so EBREAK, JALR, and ADD/HINT forms are mutually correct.
